skill.summary: Local persistent memory for OpenClaw agents. Captures conversations, extracts structured facts via LLM, and auto-recalls relevant knowledge before each turn....

latestVersion.changelog: v0.6.0: Phase 1/2/3 pipeline redesign — history-agnostic extraction (prompt in .md file), embedding-based deduplication (cosine similarity replaces LLM hints), Phase 3 relation sweep background job (auto-builds knowledge graph edges). Secret facts excluded from all LLM operations.
